records.claim_text: HR.com describes a Custom Research offer consisting of a topic-specific custom survey and branded report.
records.locator: Article body beneath displayed last update 04.30.2021
records.limitations: Old public help article; linked commercial page inaccessible. Current availability, full deliverables and charge are unconfirmed.

records.claim_text: HR.com describes sending research surveys to email-subscribed members according to their interests, using responses for reports and infographics.
records.limitations: Generic recruitment channel, not a probability sample or the exact recruitment of each report; no response-rate or nonresponse data.

records.claim_text: HR.com says its research can be obtained free of charge after account sign-in.
records.limitations: Access rule only; no redistribution licence. No account sign-in performed.

records.claim_text: The February 2025 Future of Payroll report visibly recognises IRIS as sponsor and includes publisher and sponsor profiles.
records.limitations: Sponsor recognition does not establish amount, cash versus in-kind funding, licence, exclusivity, data ownership or editorial veto.

records.claim_text: The payroll report states that its November 2024 to January 2025 survey gathered 206 HR-professional responses, mostly from North America, especially the US.
records.locator: PDF/printed page 3, About the Survey, visually inspected
records.limitations: Broad HR population, not UK-only senior payroll directors; response count is not unique annual Table capacity or representative-market evidence.
records.denominator: All reported responses to this survey

records.claim_text: HR.com describes its reports as survey-based, with advisory-board assistance in survey development, and invites participation in its research influencer panel with rewards.
records.locator: PDF/printed page 59, About HR.com and the HR Research Institute, visually inspected
records.limitations: Generic publisher description; panel rewards do not establish a specific payment, exact study incentive or sponsor contact entitlement.

records.claim_text: ISG describes an annual Buyers Guide subscription giving access to published market reports, with a 30-minute research-director inquiry included with each guide.
records.locator: Access and Inquiries to Meet Your Needs
records.limitations: Price and inquiry scheduling/usage terms not public in reviewed text; offer is not evidence of subscriptions sold.
records.denominator: Each Buyers Guide, as described by publisher

records.claim_text: ISG positions its enterprise service around provider shortlisting and an RFI-based Value Index framework; the complete market report adds detailed rankings and inclusion/product lists beyond the executive summary.
records.locator: About the Methodology; Using the Buyers Guides; Buyers Guide Research Reports
records.limitations: Declared product use, not proven buyer decision quality or guaranteed suitability.

records.claim_text: ISG offers software-provider packages that can include licensed reports and graphics for marketing-funnel or sales use, plus market consultation.
records.locator: Available in multiple packages that can include the following
records.limitations: Commercial permission category only. Exact licence scope, term, formats, price and sublicensing rights not published; no participant-list or raw-data access stated.

records.claim_text: ISG describes separate Provider Report, Provider Snapshot and Buyers Guide Insight formats with different depths of provider-specific results and commentary.
records.limitations: Descriptions do not disclose price, production cost, sales volume or exact reproduction rights.

records.claim_text: The December 2025 Global Payroll executive summary reports assessment of 14 software providers for its defined global-payroll category.
records.locator: Article date; Key Takeaways / Software Provider Summary; Appendix: Software Provider Inclusion
records.limitations: Eligibility-bound assessment of providers; not a respondent survey, 2026 release, market-share estimate or comparable price unit.

records.claim_text: ISG says eligible providers were invited to participate in the evaluation at no cost; providers meeting criteria without complete participation were assessed using public information.
records.limitations: No-cost evaluation invitation differs from paid licensing. Incomplete participation can affect ratings; no participation rate or independent audit of the independence claim is established.

records.claim_text: ISG calls the guide research independent and advises enterprises to supplement it with their own evaluation because rankings do not imply universal suitability.
records.locator: S04 opening/About the Methodology; S06 The Findings / Overall Scoring and Appendix
records.limitations: Publisher assertion and methodological caution, not independently verified editorial governance or a licence-contract protection.

records.claim_text: The Global Payroll executive summary is publicly readable and exposes the guide scope, method, summary findings and provider-inclusion caveats.
records.locator: Executive Summary; Buyers Guide Overview; Appendix
records.limitations: Free public summary is a substitute for some headline information, not a permission to republish charts or a claim of access to all paid report content.

analysis_policy: Lessons and operating requirements below are analyst inferences, not observed sales, price validation, contractual rights or adopted JGA policy.
